title: Korean restaurant in Duluth, Georgia
assumptions: The company still has to be formed (an LLC) unless an entity is named. Hires staff. Builds out the space. No new exterior sign (signage: false).

items.name: Articles of Organization (Georgia LLC)
items.agency: Georgia Secretary of State, Corporations Division
items.quote: You can register an LLC online, by mail, or in person.

items.name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
items.note: IRS: "You never have to pay a fee for an EIN."

items.name: Sales and use tax number and certificate of registration
items.quote: must register for a sales and use tax number and certificate of registration regardless of whether all sales will be online, out of state, wholesale, or exempt from tax.

items.name: Unemployment insurance tax account (DOL-1A)
items.quote: You must complete an Application for GDOL Tax Account or Status Change (DOL-1A) form and return it to the Georgia Department of Labor

items.name: Occupational Tax Certificate (business license)
items.quote: Every business in the City is required to apply for an Occupational Tax Certificate (OTC) and renew it annually in order to operate in the City limits.

items.name: Fire Marshal Certificate of Occupancy
items.quote: Additional information about the Fire Marshal Certificate of Occupancy can be obtained by calling the Gwinnett Fire Plan & Review
items.condition: The city's page points to it; when it applies to a tenant wasn't stated.

items.name: Building permit for the build-out
items.agency: City of Duluth Planning and Development
items.note: Duluth's permits page lists applications but no rule for a commercial build-out was read.

items.name: Workers' compensation insurance
items.agency: Georgia State Board of Workers' Compensation
items.note: Added in the coverage audit of 2026-10-22: bought from an insurer once there is staff. Georgia requires it of businesses with three or more workers, so it is conditional here.
items.quote: The law requires any business with three or more workers, including regular part-time workers, to have workers’ compensation insurance.
items.agencyMatch: Georgia\ State\ Board\ of\ Workers'\ Compensation

order.why: IRS: "form your entity through the secretary of state before you apply for an EIN."
Plans reviewed before construction; then the permit.
Zoning use verification is step 1; the certificate application follows Planning approval.
